summary: All six quality dimensions pass. No prior findings were raised, so nothing carries forward as unresolved. The single changed paragraph introduces the ICC process management page link with appropriate hedging, correctly distinguishing vendor-published descriptions from observed behavior and assigning follow-up for unanswered questions; the URL matches the supplied research source. Claims throughout are supported by the supplied sources and appropriately hedged. The page stays within its assigned introductory scope across all three subsections without encroaching on adjacent chapters. Prose is readable and non-repetitive. All cited URLs match supplied research source URLs or the permitted internal site path. No FAQ section appears, which is correct as none is assigned to this introduction. Workflow roles, records, decisions, and the illustrative example are present and consistent. Glossary terms introduced on this page match context definitions without restating them.
decisions: Assign follow-up when an important question about a vendor configuration remains unanswered
Distinguish an observed fact from a recommendation and an evaluation question
Record what was shown, what was described, what depended on configuration, and what remains unanswered
Identify the person who can decide the next action when a question is unanswered
Retain a limitation in the relevant record rather than assuming a software feature resolves it
